app.CreateWithCodexPrompt:
$codex-pet-dock-theme

Design a base that genuinely suits my current pet.
First offer three distinct visual directions I can choose from; do not ask me for technical parameters. After I choose, automatically generate, calibrate, validate, install, and hot-reload it. If I attach a reference image, follow its visual language.
